data.name: Mazahir
data.gender_notes: Mazahir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic context, Mazahir refers to the physical and spiritual manifestations of Allah's divine attributes and actions. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'Z-H-R' which means 'to appear' or 'to become manifest'. The name Mazahir carries the meaning “Manifestations, Appearances” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mazahir usually hope their child will grow to embody manifestations, appearances and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence and manifestation of Allah's divine attributes and blessings in our lives.
data.etymology: Mazahir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Manifestations, Appearances.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mazahir total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مظاهِر
in_arabic.meaning: تجد مظاهِر من النجوم في السماء، والمظاهِر هي الأجرام السماوية التي تظهر في السماء.
in_arabic.long_meaning: مظاهِر هو اسم علم عربي يرمز إلى الظهور أو الشهادة. يأتي هذا الاسم من مظاهِر، التي تشير إلى الأجرام السماوية مثل النجوم والقمر. في السياق الإسلامي، يُعتبر مظاهِر اسمًا شرفًا يرمز إلى البراعة والجودة. يُستخدم هذا الاسم أيضًا في القرآن في سورة الشعراء، آية 10، حيث يصف الله ظهور النجوم في السماء. يُعتبر مظاهِر اسمًا متأخرًا في العصر الإسلامي، حيث ازدهر في العصر العباسي.

in_urdu.name: مظاہِر

in_hindi.name: मظाहिर
in_hindi.meaning: नक्षत्रों के मظाहिर और चाँदी के मظाहिर
in_hindi.long_meaning: मظाहिर एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ظाहिर करना या गवाही देना। यह नाम मुहर्रम के महीने में निकलने वाले चाँद के कारण है। इस्लामिक परंपरा में, मुहर्रम एक उच्च दर्जा का नाम है जो उच्च दर्जा की क्षमता और उच्च दर्जा की समझ का प्रतीक है। यह नाम सूरह शुअरा के 10वें आयत में भी है, जिसमें अल्लाह ने चाँद के निकलने का वर्णन किया है। मुहर्रम नाम इस्लामिक काल के बाद का नाम है, जिसे अब्बासी काल में पाया गया है।

in_english.name: Mazahir
in_english.meaning: Signs or wonders in the sky, like stars or the moon
in_english.long_meaning: Mazahir is an Arabic name that means to make something visible or to be a witness. It comes from the Arabic root m-z-hr, which refers to the appearance of stars and the moon in the sky. In Islamic tradition, Mazahir is a noble name that symbolizes excellence and quality. It is also mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Shuara, verse 10, where Allah describes the appearance of the moon in the sky. Mazahir is a relatively modern name in Islamic history, emerging during the Abbasid era.
